newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock funds record outflows for 3 days.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock funds record outflows for 3 days.

text.p: U.S. stock mutual funds posted estimated industry-wide outflows of $883 million for the three days ended April 3 compared with inflows of $768 million for the two days ended March 31, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

Growth funds had outflows of $983 million versus inflows of $217 million, and aggressive growth funds posted estimated outflows of $443 million compared with outflows of $128 million. Growth and income funds posted inflows of $692 million versus inflows of $520 million, the fund tracking firm said.
International funds had inflows of $685 million versus inflows of $204 million.

Bonds funds scored a rebound, Trim Tabs said. Estimated industry inflows were $184 million versus outflows of $87 million. Muni funds posted inflows of $302 million versus outflows of $9 million. Corporate/income/global funds posted inflows of $54 million versus outflows of $162 million.
